answer: Each new identity must pass a 6-week reputation ramp: its voting weight grows 1/6 per week, and a 35 POA deposit stays frozen until week 6. Fakes cannot skip the ramp, so 1,000 fakes tie up 35,000 POA for 42 days, and every extra fake adds 35 POA; an honest user pays once. Think of a lagoon of idle capital with one bridge out, and the atlas of validators spot-checks 8% of accounts weekly for shared funding or timing; a caught fake loses its full deposit, so that total rises with N.
